source: Open-Meteo ERA5 retrospective estimates vs NOAA GHCNh hourly station proxies

failure_diagnostics.note: Diagnostic only; no threshold or model selection

limitations: ERA5 was downloaded retrospectively and can be revised. Station daily targets are proxies from quality-screened hourly reports, not true daily extrema. Overlapping forecasts and adjacent dates are dependent. This is not live forecast skill.
